note: Held out: the rule-based lockbox universe (all test years) and every instrument from 2026. Unlock once per declared run: robust_monthly (H1) and robust (H2), protocol audited2, data/lockbox-2015-2025.
universe_rule: DJIA constituents on 2015-01-02 without spin-offs, entity-replacing mergers or ticker changes in 2015-2025 (splits and cash dividends only), plus the remaining G10 currencies against USD; fixed before any of these instruments was fetched or examined

hypotheses.statement: MSTGAM with monthly decisions earns a positive excess over its exposure-matched cash/buy-and-hold blend
hypotheses.statistic: mean over instrument x test-year cells (seeds averaged) of annualized excess over the blend; one-sided t over the yearly cross-instrument means, df = years - 1
hypotheses.secondary: median cell, sign count and leave-one-instrument-out t are reported, not decisive
hypotheses.origin: 2019-2025 research runs: +5.3%/yr, t 2.8, concentrated in GRPN and GM

hypotheses.statement: Ring's selected training excess information ratio predicts its test-year excess over the blend
hypotheses.statistic: Spearman correlation over instrument x test-year cells (seeds averaged) between the selected chromosome's training excess IR and its test-year annualized excess; one-sided
hypotheses.origin: 2019-2025 research run: rho 0.19 over fold-seed fits, p 0.03
